build_dense_retriever_task: build a DenseRetrieverTask LightningModule with query and context encoders for dense retrieval training
train_dense_retriever: train a DenseRetrieverTask model using in-batch negatives and cross-entropy loss with temperature scaling
encode_queries_and_contexts: encode query token IDs and context token IDs into dense vector representations using the model encoders
compute_similarity_scores: compute similarity scores between query and context representations using matrix multiplication with optional masking
export_torchscript_encoders: export the query and context encoders to TorchScript format with optional quantization for inference
